title: Last Rites
summary: Sister Ilse says nobody said the rites for the legion in the barrows. She'd like a cleric of yours to stand where they fell and say them properly, for as long as it takes.

steps.journal: Hold five waves in a stairs-down hall of the Old Barrows, the second floor or deeper.

objectives.label: Waves held in a hall, floor 2 or deeper

ready: Go back to Sister Ilse in Thornwick.
done: Ilse taught your clerics Bless: the rites said forward, for the living, which she says is the only direction that helps.
